days.details: Check-in from 16:00 · Welcome Party from 19:30 (TBC) · Estate terrace
days.title: The Welcome
days.description:
Erin and Ryan welcome their guests to check-in at the Forte Sorgnano hamlets and sister accommodation from 16:00

Later that evening, we are kicking off the celebrations on the terrace with some freshly made pizzas and to toast the start of the celebrations!

days.note: There's a restaurant and bar on site, and most apartments have a kitchen or kitchenette. On the morning of the wedding, the wedding party will be having breakfast in the restaurant — all welcome to join.
days.title: The Wedding
days.description: The reason we're all here. The ceremony begins around 16:30–17:00 (TBC), followed by an aperitivo hour, dinner and dancing until 01:00. Full menu to follow closer to the time.

days.details: From 14:00 (TBC) · Food & drinks provided · BYOB welcome · Pool & sunshine
days.title: The Recovery
days.description: Kicking off from 14:00 (TBC) — food will be provided along with a selection of drinks, but feel free to BYOB. Lounge by the pool, dig into the barbecue and toast the weekend one last time. Bring your swimsuit and sunglasses!
